استلزمن (form X)
# اِسْتَلْزَمْنَ (istalzamna) /is.tal.zam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
# اُسْتُلْزِمْنَ (ustulzimna) /us.tul.zim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
# اِسْتَلْزِمْنَ (istalzimna) /is.tal.zim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَلْزَمَ (istalzama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
